containerOverrides.name: dbtools
command: set -e; case "$PGHOST" in *supabase*) ;; *) echo "REFUSING: PGHOST=$PGHOST is not Supabase"; exit 1;; esac; echo "TARGET=$PGHOST/$PGDATABASE"; SRC="$(echo "$DATABASE_URL" | sed "s/?.*$//")?sslmode=require"; S=$(date +%s); pg_dump "$SRC" -Fc --no-owner --no-privileges -f /tmp/d.pgc; echo "DUMP_BYTES=$(wc -c < /tmp/d.pgc)"; psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -c "DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;" 2>/dev/null; echo SCHEMA_RESET_OK; pg_restore -e -d "$PGDATABASE" --no-owner --no-privileges /tmp/d.pgc; psql -q -c "ANALYZE"; E=$(date +%s); echo "TOTAL_SECONDS=$((E-S))"; echo "--- counts (RDS -> Supabase) ---"; FAIL=0; TABLES=$(psql "$SRC" -t -A -c "SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename"); for t in $TABLES; do   A=$(psql "$SRC" -t -A -c "SELECT count(*) FROM \"$t\"" || echo ERR);   B=$(psql -t -A -c "SELECT count(*) FROM \"$t\"" || echo ERR);   if [ "$A" = "ERR" ] || [ "$B" = "ERR" ]; then M=QUERY_FAILED; FAIL=1;   elif [ "$A" = "$B" ]; then M=OK; else M=MISMATCH; FAIL=1; fi;   echo "$t: $A -> $B  $M"; done; if [ -z "$TABLES" ]; then echo "NO TABLES FOUND - DO NOT PROCEED"; exit 1; fi; if [ "$FAIL" = "1" ]; then echo "VERIFICATION FAILED - DO NOT PROCEED"; exit 1; fi; echo MIGRATE_DONE
